|---|---|---|

| B05 · Place of birth | PLACE_P1 | After substitution, arrange the place as city, state or province, and country. Supply any missing parts. |
| B06 · Sex | Female | Tick Female. |
| B07 · Marital status | Single | Tick Single. |

| B15 · Issuing authority | AUTHORITY_P1 | |

| B24 · Hotel address | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the address for each hotel. |
| B25 · Previous stays in Japan | None | |
| B26 · Current residential address | ADDRESS_P1 | |
| B27 · Tel. | PHONE_P1 | If this is your mobile number, move it to the Mobile No. field. |
| B27 · Mobile No. | NEEDS-YOU | If the supplied number is your mobile, use it here. Add another number in the appropriate field if you have one. |
| B28 · Email | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your email address. |
| B29 · Occupation and position | Staff nurse | |
| B30 · Employer name | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your employer’s name. |
| B30 · Employer telephone | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your employer’s telephone number. |
| B31 · Employer address | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your employer’s address. |
| B32 · Partner’s or parents’ occupation | NEEDS-YOU | Optional. Supply the relevant occupation if applicable. |
